title: Pricing — Council of AI living measurement
description: Free measurement, pay-as-you-go attestation, Professional & Business subscriptions, Results-as-a-Service signed packs, Enterprise regulated packs.
text: Pricing — Council of AI living measurement Home Master Sovereign GovBench Pricing Products Council FAQ Article 50 Pricing Neutral measurement should cost less than the frozen PDF it replaces. Every tier publishes its method; every figure is a signed measurement credential a third party can verify free — never a certification. Free to verify forever; metered to issue. Tier Price What you get Free £0 Single measurement, public leaderboard, Article 50 passport, verify any signed card. No card needed. Professional £59/mo 20 signed measurement cards/mo, drift re-attestation, watermark-marked export, deadline-hook monitoring (Art 50, Annex III, Machinery). Business £199/mo Unlimited signed cards, per-model fleet measurement, team arenas, re-measurement triggers when regulations change, API keys. Results-as-a-Service £500–£5,000 one-off Fixed-scope signed evidence pack: measured model/agent governance pack, Article 50 evidence pack, underwriting input, tender kit. Fastest to first cash — scoped in a call, delivered signed + OTS-anchored. Enterprise from £1,500/mo Regulated-sector packs, custom frozen splits, insurers/MGA underwriting feeds, auditor access, dedicated deployment support. Start free — signed passport in 2 minutes → · Book a Results-as-a-Service call → Self-serve card checkout arriving; paid card issuance is metered and signed on our keystone. Until then, Professional / Business / RaaS are handled in a short call — the signed pack is the deliverable, not a PDF invoice. CSOAI Ltd · UK company 16939677 · Every published figure traces to a signed, externally-verifiable record. Measurement, never certification.

register.note: CSOAI measures and publishes evidence. It issues no conformity marks and holds no accreditation. Nothing here is certification or legal advice.
